title: Pricing Plans
subtitle: Choose the perfect plan to boost your Pickleball experience.
confirmCancelDesc: Are you sure you want to cancel your subscription to {{planName}}? The subscription will not auto-renew and you will lose access to premium features once it expires.
confirmSubscribeDesc: This will activate the plan directly for your account (payment integration is currently disabled).
subscribeSuccess: Congratulations! You have successfully subscribed to {{planName}}.
errorOccurred: An error occurred. Please try again.
noActiveSubscriptions: You do not have any active subscriptions.
confirmSubscribeVNPayDesc: You will be redirected to VNPay to finish subscribing to "{{planName}}". After payment succeeds, your plan will activate immediately.
vnpaySecureNote: Secure payment via VNPay, supporting domestic cards, international cards, and e-wallets.

paymentReturn.successDescription: Your subscription plan has been activated successfully.
paymentReturn.successBadge: Payment via VNPay has been confirmed
paymentReturn.successBody: You can start using the plan features right away. You will be redirected back to the subscriptions page in {{countdown}} seconds.
paymentReturn.successHelp: If you run into any issues, please contact support.
paymentReturn.failureDescription: Your transaction has not been completed.
paymentReturn.failureBody: Your subscription has not been activated. You can try again at any time. You will be redirected back to the subscriptions page in {{countdown}} seconds.

responseCodes.10: Transaction failed because the card/account authentication failed more than 3 times.
responseCodes.11: Transaction failed because the payment timeout expired. Please try again.
responseCodes.12: Transaction failed because the card/account is locked.
responseCodes.13: Transaction failed because the OTP password was entered incorrectly.
responseCodes.24: Transaction failed because the customer cancelled the transaction.
responseCodes.51: Transaction failed because the account does not have enough balance.
responseCodes.65: Transaction failed because the transaction limit for the day was exceeded.
responseCodes.75: The payment bank is under maintenance.
responseCodes.79: Transaction failed because the payment password was entered incorrectly too many times.
responseCodes.07: Transaction successful but suspicious (fraud or unusual activity).
responseCodes.09: Transaction failed because the customer has not registered Internet Banking with the bank.
